title: Cantilever beam plastic bending
line: A nonlinear FEA study of a steel cantilever beam loaded past first yield.
description: Elastic-plastic bending of a steel cantilever beam (1000 x 100 x 100 mm) fixed at one end. A 48 kN force on the free end takes the root past first yield, with J2 plasticity and linear hardening, applied in load increments with Newton iteration.
thumbnailAlt: Stress in a steel cantilever beam loaded past first yield, solved in RunMat
